name: fade-through
title: Fade Through
description: A calm transition primitive that fades one layer out, passes through a wash, and reveals the next layer. Mount it inside a clip with data-composition-id="fade-through": its own timeline nests there.

variables.label: Wash
variables.description: Colour of the mid-transition frame: paper is the light --fg (through --hf-fade-through-wash), ink the reel ground --bg.

variables.label: Strength
variables.description: How far the wash covers at its peak. 1 is a full flash, 0.3 a light veil.

variables.label: Shape
variables.description: Flat fills the frame evenly, bloom concentrates the wash in the centre.
